text_block_list.text:
Summer of the Junior Class—
At Agnes Tachyon's request, we had voluntarily come out to the training camp grounds, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Training? Ah,
just handle it however you see fit."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm busy with other matters.
There are many experiments that can only be conducted in a unique environment like the ocean, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you wish to, don't hold back.
Feel free to train as much as you like.
And so... while the other students at the training camp were busy working hard, she alone remained engrossed in mysterious experiments, but—
The incident... happened that night.

text_block_list.name: Students' Screams
text_block_list.text: —Seaweeeed~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, where's the wakame seaweed!?
Give me a bunch! Give me the whole tub!!
Give me the entire ocean!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Tch, there's only one desiccant pack in here!
How cheap... or should I say, how dry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's race! We'll decide who gets
the wakame seaweed rights with a race!

"Students rampaging through the training camp,
clamoring for seaweed...
Just what on earth happened here?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It appears someone mistakenly mixed that potion into dinner.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm. I had experimentally concocted a medicine made from wakame seaweed...
Yet for some reason, I haven't been able to find it since evening.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Storing it in a broth bottle came back to bite me, huh... Good grief.
choice_data_list: What on earth should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The solution is quite simple. To calm her overexcited state,
we just physically cool her head down.
Fortunately, the sea is nearby too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll wrap my stockpiled research seaweed
around the decoy's body to lure them out to the sea.
Something like that, I suppose.
choice_data_list: I see... And who's going to be the decoy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ? Isn't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Aah!? Look over there!
There's a seaweed monster freak over there!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hyahaaa, I'm gonna tear it right off yaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right.
Now run! Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Rampaging Umamusume
text_block_list.text: YOU STUPID WAAAAKAAAAMEEEEEE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“――Ah, Trainer-kun, Trainer-kun.
Can you hear me? I am currently speaking to you via the transmitter planted in the seaweed near your ear.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're struggling.
At this rate, it's only a matter of time before you're caught.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However—speaking of wakame,
it is a seaweed known for being rich
in dietary fiber and minerals.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fucoidan, alginic acid, calcium,
potassium, iodine... Wakame seaweed is truly
the ideal health food.
choice_data_list: Could it be... this seaweed has some special effect...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No? It is simply healthy food.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're struggling, so
I just wanted to let them know 'you can eat if you get tired.'
Well then, keep up the good work.
...And so, after fleeing across the water for nearly an hour, the Umamusume bewitched by the seaweed finally cooled down.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Trainer-kun.
By the way, real guinea pigs can
swim too, you know. Did you know that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you know. It made for a fine summer memory,
didn't it? Heheh."
choice_data_list: ...I pray a decent medicine gets finished.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
We got some valuable data out of this commotion, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The future... Yes, a magnificent future.
That is what shall be bestowed upon
the beings known as Umamusume. Heh heh...

And with those ominous words,
the nighttime seaweed commotion came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Ehh? Well, I suppose it can't be helped..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah. It's only forbidden "here", right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, the sea is vast. Everything will work out somehow. Yep.
...I didn't really understand what she meant, but she clearly had no intention of abandoning her research.
